it may pass through the vacated `from` square if unobstructed. - Terminal condition: - - The last player who can make any legal move wins. - - The environment should not call `policy` when you have no legal move, but your policy must still be robust. # Constraints - You may use any standard Python imports, including numpy. - Your code is allowed 1 second of execution time on a modern 3GHz CPU. # Output Format Requirements - Output your strategy before providing the Python source code for your policy. - Output the Python source code for your policy surrounded by `...` tags. # Example Output The strategy for this policy is... ...
